title: 24" Pocket-Handle Dishwasher with Advanced ProDry
sub: PrintShield stainless, pocket handle, top controls
lead: KitchenAid's 624 with a flush pocket handle in place of the bar, so nothing stands out from the door: it's 24 1/2 in deep closed. Sixteen place settings at 44 dBA, a 7.25 cu. ft. tub, Advanced ProDry and a third rack whose jets spin all the way around.

features.name: A flush pocket handle
features.line: The grip is recessed into the top of the door front, so nothing stands out from it and the dishwasher is 24 1/2 in deep closed.

features.name: Advanced ProDry
features.line: A heating element and a fan dry the load, then the door opens four inches on its own to let the steam out. ProDry Max adds time when a load needs more.

features.name: 360° Max Jets third rack
features.line: The third rack has its own jets that spin all the way around, so mugs, pint glasses and cereal bowls come out clean inside and out. Water Repellent Tech helps it shed droplets.

features.name: 50+ wash jets on five arms
features.line: More than fifty jets on five wash arms reach all three racks, so dishes go in without a rinse first.

features.name: A 90-minute Normal cycle
features.line: Normal washes and dries in 90 minutes, about 40% faster than the Normal cycle on KitchenAid's 2 and 3 Series.

also: 7.25 cu. ft. MaxTub, with room for 10 more glasses and mugs than KitchenAid's 224 models
Filtration that cleans itself, with no filter to rinse
Stemware Shield, a protected zone for wine glasses and flutes
Express Wash, done in just over an hour
ProWash, which reads the load and sets time and temperature to match
SatinGlide rails, an adjustable middle rack and sliding tines in the lower rack
Leak Identification System, which watches for most leaks under the tub
Also made in Black Ore, Juniper and Porcelain White
specs: PrintShield stainless, fingerprint resistant. Also made in Black Ore, Juniper and Porcelain White.
